name: PitchBook Premium
description: Bring the depth of PitchBook's industry-leading private capital market intelligence into Claude. Powered by our MCP server, PitchBook clients can seamlessly search and analyze firms, deals, funds, and key players—unlocking trusted insights for confident decisions, actionable intelligence, and market benchmarking, all within their AI workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PitchBook Premium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PitchBook Premium to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is PitchBook Premium MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, PitchBook Premium scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PitchBook Premium MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PitchBook Premium lists 16 MCP tools, including pitchbook_search, pitchbook_get_profile, pitchbook_get_company_deals, pitchbook_get_company_investors, pitchbook_get_company_financials, pitchbook_get_deal_participants, pitchbook_get_deal_cap_table, pitchbook_get_investor_funds, pitchbook_get_investor_investments, pitchbook_get_fund_lp_commitments, pitchbook_get_team_members, and pitchbook_get_news_analysis.
